description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractSearchMappingStrategies, which provides helper methods to map Adaptable objects to search commands and events within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. The class includes methods to extract selected fields and subscription IDs from Adaptable payloads and uses generic types for flexibility.

classes.name: AbstractSearchMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to search-related signals and commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It is parameterized with a type T that extends Jsonifiable.WithPredicate, facilitating flexible mapping strategies.

methods.name: AbstractSearchMappingStrategies
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mapping strategies with a given map of string to JsonifiableMapper.

methods.name: selectedFieldsFrom
methods.description: A protected static method that retrieves selected JsonFieldSelector from an Adaptable's payload, returning null if not present.

methods.name: subscriptionIdFrom
methods.description: A protected static method that extracts the subscription ID string from an Adaptable's payload, returning null if not present.

methods.name: getFromValue
methods.description: A static generic method that retrieves a value of type T from an Adaptable's payload given a JsonFieldDefinition, wrapped in an Optional.
